borrowerOf(uint256).details: Returns address(0) if not rented or if the rental has expired         but reclaimExpired() has not yet been called (stale state check).

cancelListing(uint256).details: Cannot cancel a Rented listing; wait for rental to expire first.

params.listingId: ID of the listing to cancel.

claimFees().details: Zeroes the balance before the transfer to prevent reentrancy.

params.feeRecipient_: Address that receives the protocol slice of rental fees.
params.initialFeeBps: Protocol fee in bps (e.g. 200 = 2 %). Must be <= MAX_FEE_BPS.

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

list(address,uint256,uint256,uint8,uint2.details: For ERC-721 `amount` must be 1. The NFT is transferred here immediately.

params.amount: Number of tokens (must be 1 for ERC-721, >=1 for ERC-1155).
params.maxDuration: Maximum rental duration in seconds (≥ minDuration).
params.pricePerDay: Price in AETH per day (18 decimals).

returns.lenderFee: Net AETH credited to the lender.
returns.totalFee: Gross AETH the borrower must pay.

reclaimExpired(uint256).details: Only the original lender may call this.         The listing returns to Available state after reclaim.

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

rent(uint256,uint256).details: Total fee = pricePerDay * duration / SECONDS_PER_DAY.         Protocol fee is forwarded to feeRecipient immediately.         Lender net fee is credited to pendingFees (pull-over-push).

params.duration: Rental duration in seconds; must be in [minDuration, maxDuration].
params.listingId: ID of the listing to rent.

returnEarly(uint256).details: No refund is issued; fee was already credited to the lender.         Only the active borrower may call this.         The listing returns to Available state, ready for re-rental.

params.rentalId: ID of the rental to close.

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.newFeeBps: New fee in basis points (max MAX_FEE_BPS).

borrowerOf(uint256).notice: Return the current active borrower of a listing.

cancelListing(uint256).notice: Cancel an Available listing and retrieve the escrowed NFT.

feeRecipient().notice: Receives the protocol slice of every rental fee.

isActivelyRented(uint256).notice: Return true if the listing is Rented and the rental has not expired.

list(address,uint256,uint256,uint8,uint2.notice: Deposit an NFT into escrow and create a rental listing.

protocolFeeBps().notice: Protocol fee in basis points (e.g. 200 = 2 %). Max 1 000 bps.

quoteFee(uint256,uint256).notice: Quote the fee breakdown for renting a listing for 'duration' seconds.

reclaimExpired(uint256).notice: Reclaim an escrowed NFT whose rental period has elapsed.

rent(uint256,uint256).notice: Rent a listed NFT for 'duration' seconds.

returnEarly(uint256).notice: Return a rented NFT before the rental period expires.

setFeeRecipient(address).notice: Update the address that receives the protocol fee slice.

setProtocolFee(uint256).notice: Update the protocol fee. Applies to future rentals only.
